chapters.label: Dream debut
chapters.text: Anfield, January 2018: Virgil van Dijk's first game for Liverpool, in red, against Everton, in blue. One-all, eighty-four minutes. Oxlade-Chamberlain swings in a corner... Van Dijk rises... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The keeper, Jordan Pickford, rushes off his line to catch it. Van Dijk times his jump and gets there first.

chapters.label: Highest point
chapters.text: From behind the goal: he meets the ball at its highest point, before Pickford can. Into the net, in front of the Kop!

chapters.label: Time your jump
chapters.text: Don't jump too early! Time your jump, and meet the ball at its highest point.
